about_the_game:
Classic Point-and-Click Adventure Game to experience the feeling from the 80's and 90's | Tech-Noir | Pixel Art and Retro Style | Interactive visual novel

Step into Warden’s shoes, solve puzzles, collect items, discover new places, talk to quirky characters, and uncover your destiny - and that of the universe - through conversations and unique moments in a mysterious story.

The capital melts away in the dying heat of dusk. At the heart of the boundless metropolis, a mysterious building wrapped in dark secrets rises in silence. Through the fragile fabric of space-time, its story begins to unfold - a tale where past, present, and future collide.
